about_the_game:
YOU play the boss! YOU play the heroes!

Mythbreak is a PvP arena brawler featuring fast-paced 3v1 asymmetrical gameplay. Dive into the action as one of three heroes working together to take down a fearsome boss or become the boss itself and unleash havoc on your fiends. Whether you are coordinating strategies as a team or dominating the battlefield with sheer force, Mythbreak offers dynamic battles packed with action.

Each hero and boss boasts a different skill set and playstyle, opening up countless strategies and ways to play. Combining the thrill of raid battles with the competitive spirit of an arena brawler, Mythbreak delivers a fresh and engaging gameplay experience every time!

As an online multiplayer game with a focus on teamwork, Mythbreak is designed to be a shared experience. Rally your squad, choose your roles and battle it out.

Delve into the Eddyr, a magical relic that seals ancient myths within its pages. As you face its vengeful bosses or fight human heroes, collect lore to gradually uncover their histories and the stories behind them, get achivements and unlock skins to show off.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
